meta_description:
48 likes, 1 comments - consciousindianparents on July 31, 2026: "**SAVE THIS IF YOU’RE PREGNANT** 

Pregnancy changes more than just your body..it should also make you rethink your skincare routine.

Many common anti-ageing, acne and pigmentation products may contain ingredients that are generally not recommended during pregnancy, so always check the ingredient list.

In this reel, I’ve shared:
✔️ Ingredients to look out for
✔️ The type of sunscreen to choose
✔️ A pregnancy-focused skincare option by @orimiiskincare to make things simpler

💛 Save this reel for your next skincare shopping trip and share it with an expecting mama.

#pregnancyskincare #pregnancycare #pregnancytips #pregnancysafe #expectingmom PregnancyJourney IndianMoms SkincareTips HealthyPregnancy Motherhood PregnancyEducation Orimii".
